# Tess OS project context (Gemini CLI)

<!-- Generated by `tessctl render --target gemini` from .tess/core/templates/gemini/GEMINI.md.tpl. Change the core template and re-render; do not hand-edit. -->

This project runs Tess OS. Its operating rules are the `AGENTS.md` digest,
imported below so they load once, through this file. Do not also add
`AGENTS.md` to `context.fileName` in `.gemini/settings.json`: the rules
would then load twice.

Tess commands are available as `/tess:<name>`, for example `/tess:wake` or
`/tess:help`. Gemini CLI loads this file and those commands only in a
trusted folder.

No Tess session hook runs under Gemini CLI. The ship-gate described in
`AGENTS.md` is enforced at git pre-push and in CI, not inside this session.

@./AGENTS.md
